Leaves of the main stem with the blades 7.9 - 8.1 x 2.7 - 3.1 cm, lanceolate, velutinous-pubescent, the venation pinnate, camptodromous, with 6 - 8 secondary veins; the base obtuse, the margins entire, ciliate, the apex attenuate; petioles of leaves on main stem 10 - 11 mm long,
